## What's missing / what would you like to see

A clear description of the gap or the feature you'd like.

## Check first

- [ ] I checked [`docs/TASKS.md`](../../docs/TASKS.md) — this isn't already planned, in progress,
      or explicitly deferred for a stated reason.
- [ ] I checked [`docs/DECISIONS.md`](../../docs/DECISIONS.md) — this hasn't already been proposed
      and rejected (if it has, feel free to open the issue anyway if you think the reasoning no
      longer holds — just say so).
- [ ] If this is a new cryptographic primitive/mode: I have (or can point to) a specific DSTU
      clause or reference-implementation source for it — see `docs/SECURITY.md` "No primitive
      without a cited spec section."

## Why this matters

What does this unblock, or what's the use case? (Helps prioritize against `docs/TASKS.md`'s
existing backlog.)

## Possible approach (optional)

If you have thoughts on how this should be implemented/shaped — especially relevant for anything
touching the public API, since this project follows a libsodium-style "no misconfigurable knobs"
philosophy (see `docs/dstu-crypto-project.md`).
